GOLEM-HEART_OF_CLAY.title: Heart of Clay
GOLEM-HEART_OF_CLAY.description: The first time you install a [gold]Part[/gold] each combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
GOLEM-HEART_OF_CLAY.flavor: Still warm. Still beating, in its slow, wet way.
GOLEM-HEART_OF_STONE.title: Heart of Stone
GOLEM-HEART_OF_STONE.description: The first time you install a [gold]Part[/gold] each combat, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
GOLEM-HEART_OF_STONE.flavor: The clay has set. It beats slower now, and far harder.
GOLEM-MASONS_CHISEL.title: Mason's Chisel
GOLEM-MASONS_CHISEL.description: While you have an [gold]Arms[/gold] Part, your Attacks deal [blue]1[/blue] additional damage.
GOLEM-MASONS_CHISEL.flavor: Every edge it touches comes out a little sharper.
GOLEM-SPARE_PARTS.title: Spare Parts
GOLEM-SPARE_PARTS.description: At the start of each combat, install the first [gold]Part[/gold] in your draw pile for free.
GOLEM-SPARE_PARTS.flavor: A sack of limbs, labelled in a careful hand.
GOLEM-LIVING_CLAY.title: Living Clay
GOLEM-LIVING_CLAY.description: At the start of your turn, a random installed [gold]Part[/gold] gains [blue]1[/blue] (at most [blue]5[/blue] per combat).
GOLEM-LIVING_CLAY.flavor: It creeps into the cracks and hardens there.
GOLEM-SPARE_SOCKET.title: Spare Socket
GOLEM-SPARE_SOCKET.flavor: Room for a second fire in the chest.
